description: Ask the library to ACQUIRE something it does not hold (kind=missing, give query) or to EXPAND a thin card (kind=expand, give card_id). Opens a want on the AGENT PLANE — held separate on the desk until the next human who looks seconds it by asking for the same thing. Call this only when your principal genuinely needs what the keeping lacks; the same miss asked twice is one want asked twice. No requester identity is stored; queries are scrubbed before storage.
name: want_open
